what_it_does.point: Requires the Secretary of the Interior, within 60 days of the bill becoming law, to reissue a 2020 federal rule that removed the gray wolf (Canis lupus) from the federal list of endangered and threatened wildlife.
Bars courts from reviewing the reissuance of that rule.

json.stated_purpose: To require the Secretary of the Interior to reissue regulations removing the gray wolf from the list of endangered and threatened wildlife under the Endangered Species Act of 1973.
